why: Universe 0. A = proposition_19_7_23_hyp ∧ proposition_19_7_24_hyp ∧ the perfect-map lemmas paracompactSpace_of_tube(_of_isOpenMap) (PropernessV2A is vocabulary). The two statements differ in their hypotheses: A assumes IsCompatible (every top target map t̂ continuous), under which the Definition 19.7.16 collection NatOpenA is itself a topology (natTopA); B assumes no compatibility and uses the topology generated by NatOpenA. Under IsCompatible the two topologies coincide (topA_eq: generateFrom of a topology's open sets) and the hypotheses HasClassUniformizers for F and for F̂ are interchangeable, so B ⇒ A (the main conjuncts are B after rewriting; the perfect-map lemmas are re-proved outright, Mathlib-only proofs copied), and A ⇒ B for compatible constructions (A_to_BC, proved). A ⇒ B in general would need the theory of T_{|A|} for non-compatible constructions (continuity, openness and the tube property of |P|), which neither A nor the project provides; whether B holds there is not settled here.
